$comment: Tabs / segmented control. Its own tokens own the TRACK (rail), the idle label, and the tab's SIZE (a comfortable, tappable control — roomy padding + readable mono label, matching the portfolio's About-page slider). The active indicator borrows only Badge's PALETTE + treatment (--badge-bg-*, --badge-radius, --badge-border-*, --badge-fg) directly in Tabs.css, so a lit tab and a Badge share one look per hue — but a tab is deliberately larger than a category Badge.

track-radius.comment: matches the pill — the rail is a control, not a container, so it takes the same radius the indicator does (999px round in Confetti, 12px in Adventure, square in Neon)

hover-fg.comment: an idle tab warms to full-strength text on hover, short of the lit pill

font-size.comment: 14px mono — the control label, sized for legibility

tab-padding-x.comment: 20px — roomy, so the control reads at a comfortable tap size
